_comment: Example sidecar: material settings applied on top of a model's exported materials. Pass it with ?sidecar=, multi-select it with a model in the file dialog, or drag-drop it. Property reference: threejs.org/docs -> MeshPhysicalMaterial.

materials._comment: Keys are mesh names ('Dragon' below targets the bundled glass dragon); '*' is the fallback for every mesh without its own entry. Keys starting with underscore are comments.
